take: Carolina announced it has placed left wing Taylor Hall on injured reserve. Hall has three goals and five points in eight games, and the Hurricanes controlled 63 percent of the expected goals (a measure of shot quality) at five-on-five with him on the ice, about 7 points better than without him. In the two games he has missed, Bradly Nadeau has stepped into his spot beside Stankoven and Blake, while William Carrier (14:36 a night, up from 12:55) and Sebastian Aho (21:11, up from 19:36) have absorbed the extra minutes.
